missionPremise: A-081 (OPS-17, 2026-08-19): eleven domains are registered and generate deterministic fixture data and they REACH NO PIXEL. Four consecutive waves built everything underneath the lenses and never the lenses. Underneath that sits RULING 1 (A-076, operator-approved in _inbox/2026-08-19_template_city_lens_build_sheet.md): 'not built' moved down one level from describing the SURFACE to describing SOURCES, because the product could not distinguish 'we did not build Parks' from 'your city has no Parks data'. G-91 built the seam that makes the distinction expressible and W2DS/W2DEPT filled it; this lane makes it VISIBLE. Operator priority, in his words carried in the dispatch: Development services must match the data the PRODUCTION Bastrop dashboard shows today, because it monitors the MyGov system the city already runs.

compositionPlan.principle: one data path. The regions consume the SEAM's composed payload through the routes that already exist. No fetch of a vendor, no second generator, no shape the generators do not return, no server route added.

dataPath.otherFour: GET /api/domains/<id>?cityKey= -> composeDomainById(), which carries status, granted, generated, basis, recordCount, countingRule, records[] and extras{}. Four parallel fetches at boot beside loadPipeline. NO new endpoint: the route has shipped since G-91 and src/server.test.mjs:543 already gates it.

adversarialReviewOfThisPlan.risk: rendering 82 records at once turns a quiet surface into a wall, which is the visual law's first rule broken by the lane meant to honour it
adversarialReviewOfThisPlan.mitigation: register-not-card-deck throughout: one metric strip plus tables and registers, existing carriers only. Severity reaches the pixel through the kit pill families the payload's own `severity` field names, so exceptions are loud because the DATA says so, not because markup decorates them.

adversarialReviewOfThisPlan.risk: the addressability gate and the hidden-branch gate. Every new hidden branch must carry an id AND be reachable by a served script, or the gate reports a dead branch.
adversarialReviewOfThisPlan.mitigation: every records wrapper is toggled by getElementById in web/app.js with a literal id, which is exactly what the gate's F1 rule resolves. The 14 BASELINE_HIDDEN entries are a superset assertion, so adding branches is allowed; dropping one is not, and ds-pipeline-mark, ds-pipeline-prov and ds-pipeline-records all survive.
